The '''Drongar system''' was a star system located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="TEA" /> It contained the planet [[Drongar/Legends|Drongar]] and the primary star [[Drongar Prime]].<ref name="MBS" />
